name: StoreAgent – WooCommerce AI Chatbot, AI Agent & WooCommerce MCP Server
author: Josh Kohlbach

sections.description:
🟡 WooCommerce AI Agents for Chat, Support and Store Management

StoreAgent brings WooCommerce AI to your store in three ways. A WooCommerce AI chatbot answers shoppers 24/7. A WooCommerce MCP server connects ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or any other MCP client to your store. A set of AI agents writes your product descriptions, tags, alt text and review summaries. All of it works from your real catalogue: titles, attributes, variations, live prices, stock and reviews.

There are no OpenAI or other LLM API keys to find or pay for. Connect your store and the AI features switch on.

👉 You’ll need a free StoreAgent.ai account to activate the AI features.

💬 WooCommerce Chatbot for AI Customer Service and Support

Most store support is the same few questions. Where is my order? Is this in stock? Does it come in blue? The StoreAgent store chatbot answers them in under 10 seconds from your own products, pages and policies, and cuts repetitive support questions by 70% or more. Your team only sees the conversations that need a person.

What the AI chat does on your storefront:

🟢 Product-aware answers from titles, specs, attributes, variations and reviews, including per-variation pricing on variable products
🟢 Live price and stock read at the moment it answers, so it never quotes a stale figure
🟢 Order lookups for signed-in shoppers, which you can switch off in the Privacy setting
🟢 In-chat coupon offers to move a hesitant shopper over the line
🟢 Human escalation that hands billing, refund and cancellation topics to a person, and emails you unresolved chats with the customer set as reply-to
🟢 Competitor blocklist so the chatbot never names brands you choose
🟢 Tone control, a custom avatar and conversation starters that let the widget speak first
🟢 Multi-language replies in each shopper’s own language
🟢 Guest and logged-in support, with full chat history on paid plans

🛒 An AI Chatbot That Knows Your WooCommerce Store

Choose which post types feed the chatbot (products, posts, pages, or any mix) and StoreAgent keeps that index in sync as you publish and edit. You can exclude pages, watch indexing progress as a live percentage, and re-sync any post type on demand. The chatbot stays hidden until the first index finishes, so no shopper meets a chatbot that knows nothing yet. Answers can cite the store content they came from.

Match the widget to your brand with colours, greeting text and screen position, open it by default, or place it inline with a shortcode. Preview mode lets you test answers before shoppers see them.

The dashboard tracks chatbot impressions, conversations and chat-to-cart events as a KPI band and a conversion funnel, with a plain-English briefing you can share with your team.

🔌 WooCommerce MCP Server: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard AI assistants use to connect to outside tools. StoreAgent includes a WooCommerce MCP server, so ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor or any other MCP client can work directly with your store. Think of it as ChatGPT for WooCommerce, using the assistant you already pay for.

Add your store as a custom connector, approve the connection in wp-admin, and your assistant can read store data and, where you allow it, act for you. Read-only abilities are on by default. Anything that makes changes stays off until you switch it on, and a 30-day activity log shows every action a connected assistant took. WooCommerce MCP is included on every plan, including free.

Things store owners ask their AI assistant through WooCommerce MCP:

🤖 How many orders came in this week, compared with last week?
🤖 Which orders are paid but not shipped yet?
🤖 Which products are low on stock or sold out?
🤖 Write a description for each product that is missing one, for me to review.
🤖 Which products have no tags, upsells or cross-sells? Fill the gaps.
🤖 Summarise the reviews for this product.
🤖 What questions do shoppers keep asking the chatbot?

For order and stock data, the MCP server uses WooCommerce’s own abilities (WooCommerce 10.9 and later), so your assistant sees live data, not a copy.

🧩 A WordPress MCP Server for Your Other Plugins Too

More WordPress and WooCommerce plugins now register abilities through the WordPress Abilities API. StoreAgent’s MCP server picks up every ability on your site automatically, so Claude or ChatGPT can use a new plugin’s abilities as soon as you install it. The same permission rules apply to every ability. StoreAgent also exposes 30 of its own abilities, so other AI tools on your site can call its agents directly.

✍️ AI Agents for WooCommerce Product Content

Every plan includes AI agents for the content jobs you keep putting off:

✍️ Product, short and category descriptions written for SEO
🏷️ Product tags, plus a scheduled check that finds untagged products
⭐ Review summaries that turn long review threads into social proof
🖼️ Image alt text, generated automatically for new product images
🤝 Upsell and cross-sell suggestions
🎟️ Coupon descriptions
🛡️ Review moderation that triages incoming product reviews
❓ Product Q&A with an Ask a Question widget on the product page

Run an agent on one product, on a sample, or in bulk from the products list or WP-CLI. “Complete with AI” fills out a thin product in one click, and each agent shows its credit cost before it runs. StoreAgent also watches description length and quality, and sends one-click fixes to your dashboard.

🌍 Works With Your WooCommerce Stack

StoreAgent works with any WooCommerce-ready theme, including block themes. It integrates with Wholesale Suite (respecting wholesale role pricing), WC Vendors and SiteGround Optimizer. Front-end assets are lightweight and CDN-served, and the AI runs on StoreAgent.ai, not on your server.

🆓 Get Started for Free

The free Lite plan includes the WooCommerce chatbot, WooCommerce MCP and the AI content tools. Keep it as long as you like, and upgrade when you need higher limits or advanced features.

See all plans at storeagent.ai/pricing/.

Use of Third-Party Services

This plugin connects your store to the StoreAgent.ai service to power the AI chatbot and the AI content tools. A free StoreAgent.ai account is required.

When enabled, the plugin sends the content you select for indexing (for example product titles, descriptions, attributes, prices and reviews) and the messages shoppers type into the chatbot to StoreAgent.ai, which generates the responses and content and returns them to your site.

  • Service: StoreAgent.ai
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

When you connect an AI client such as Claude or ChatGPT through MCP, that client can read customer personal data from your store, such as names, email addresses, billing and shipping addresses, order totals, order notes, and refund details. Data a client reads leaves your store and is processed by the AI provider behind that client. Add this to your privacy policy before you connect a client.

When you deactivate the plugin, a short “Quick Feedback” form asks why you are leaving. It is sent to StoreAgent.ai only when you choose Submit & Deactivate. Choosing Skip & Deactivate, closing the form with Escape, or clicking outside it sends nothing at all, and nothing is sent before you choose Submit. When you do submit, the form sends the reason you picked, anything you typed in the comment box, your site address, your plan, and version details for the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce. Your email address is included only if you tick “You can email me about this.”

Please make sure this is compatible with your own privacy policy and applicable data protection laws before enabling the chatbot on a live store.

Feedback and Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature suggestions, please reach out to us at support@storeagent.ai.

Have an idea for an AI tool? Let us know.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file (if installing manually).
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to StoreAgent > Settings to connect your StoreAgent.ai account and switch on the chatbot and the AI agents you want.
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreAgent.ai account?

Yes. The free plan is enough to run everything in this plugin. Sign up here.

Is this a free WooCommerce AI chatbot plugin?

Yes. The free plan includes the AI chatbot, WooCommerce MCP and the AI content tools, so you can run it on your store without paying anything.

Do I need an OpenAI or other LLM API key?

No. Your StoreAgent.ai account handles the AI, so everything works as soon as your store is connected.

Which AI assistants can I connect through WooCommerce MCP?

Any MCP client, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Grok Bot and Cursor. Turn on MCP under StoreAgent > Settings > MCP, add your store as a custom connector in your assistant, and approve the connection from wp-admin. Read-only abilities work straight away. Abilities that make changes stay off until you allow them.

What is the chatbot trained on?

Your own content. StoreAgent indexes the products, posts and pages you choose, including titles, descriptions, attributes, variations, prices and reviews. The chatbot appears on your storefront once the first index completes.

Can the chatbot handle customer service questions?

Yes, and that is what most stores use it for. It answers product, shipping, policy and order questions from your own content. Anything it can’t resolve is emailed to you as a conversation summary with the customer set as reply-to.

Is this an AI shopping assistant as well as a support chatbot?

Both. Because it knows your catalogue, it helps shoppers compare products, check price and stock and find the right item, and it also answers everyday support questions.

Will the chatbot slow my store down?

No. The front-end assets are lightweight and CDN-served, and the AI runs on StoreAgent.ai rather than on your server.

Is StoreAgent GDPR-compliant?

The plugin is built to be GDPR-compliant. Conversations and content are processed by StoreAgent.ai, so please review the third-party services section above and your own privacy policy before you enable it on a live store.

How is this different from other AI chatbot plugins?

Most AI chatbot plugins are general-purpose: you hand them a sitemap and hope. StoreAgent is built for WooCommerce, so it understands products, variations, live prices, orders and coupons. The same plugin also writes your product content and connects your AI assistant to your store through WooCommerce MCP.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Feature: A scheduled check now finds published products with no tags and sends you a notification — click Accept to generate and save the tags with the Product Tags Generator AI
  • Improvement: The Connection tab now shows when an annual plan renews and when its usage resets
  • Improvement: General security and privacy hardening
  • Bug Fix: Annual plans unlocked only the free-tier chat settings instead of their paid features
  • Bug Fix: Lite plans show their lifetime allocation on the Connection tab again
  • Bug Fix: Permanently deleting a product now always removes it from AI Memory

Older releases are listed in changelog.txt in the plugin folder, and in the plugin’s full version history on WordPress.org.
